title: Pullback-square route localizes the underived restricted counit
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $V\subset Y$ open, $U=f^{-1}V$, and $f_0:U\to V$. Use the same notation $F,F_0,r_X,r_Y,e_h,Q_h,\rho_X,\rho_Y$ from [def-pc-e2-open-homotopy-direct-image-iso], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] and [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Put $t_I=\rho_Y(F_hI)\gg R_Y(\beta_F(I))$. Let $a_f$ be the pinned derived adjunction [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-adjunction], $c$ the pinned pullback composition [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-composition], and $\varepsilon_{f_0}$ its left-derived counit [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. For every homotopy-category object $I$, the composite $Lf_0^*(t_I)$, followed by the explicit five pullback-square factors (inverse open comparison on Y, c along f0 and the open inclusion, transport along commutativity, inverse c along the inclusion of U and f, open comparison on X), followed by $R_X(a_f.\mathrm{counit}(Q_hI))$, equals $Lf_0^*(Q_h(e_h(I)))\gg\varepsilon_{f_0}(F_{0h}r_{Xh}I)\gg Q_h(\mathrm{counit}_{f_0,h}(r_{Xh}I))\gg\rho_X(I)$. The latter counit is the homotopy-category image of the chosen underived tensor-pullback adjunction. This assertion involves no derived open direct-image comparison b and requires no boundedness or K-injectivity of I.
